description: Aggregates Dialogflow CX transcript data into distinct user interactions, determines head intent, checks for self-service action completion, and captures interaction disposition.

schema.description: The GCP location of the agent
schema.name: location

schema.description: The user-provided identifier for the agent
schema.name: agent_id

schema.description: The fully qualified unique ID for the session
schema.name: session_id

schema.description: The timestamp at which the session started
schema.name: session_start_time

schema.description: The position of the interaction within the session
schema.name: interaction_position

schema.description: The reverse position of the interaction within the session
schema.name: interaction_position_reverse

schema.description: The head intent of the interaction
schema.name: interaction_head_intent

schema.description: The timestamp at which the interaction started
schema.name: start_interaction_time

schema.description: The timestamp at which the interaction ended
schema.name: end_interaction_time

fields.description: The human readable name of the task
fields.name: task_display_name

fields.description: Whether the action started in the task
fields.name: action_started

fields.description: The timestamp at which the action started
fields.name: action_started_time

fields.description: Whether the action ended in the task
fields.name: action_ended

fields.description: The timestamp at which the action ended
fields.name: action_ended_time

schema.description: The timestamp at which the record was last inserted
schema.name: latest_insert_time
